Upstream Triton is not vendored in this archive. KOMP pins triton-lang/triton v3.8.0,
commit c01b6774b1865984607d89d89d3a10833de92037 (komp/patches/PIN, komp/patches/VERSION).

Running KOMP only needs the stock wheel:   pip install triton==3.8.0
(the fork's one added module is installed by komp/tools/install_fork.sh, or loaded from the patch file).

To apply or edit the patch series, fetch the pinned tree here:
  git clone --depth 1 --branch v3.8.0 https://github.com/triton-lang/triton komp/third_party/triton
  git -C komp/third_party/triton rev-parse HEAD    # must print c01b6774b1865984607d89d89d3a10833de92037
  komp/tools/apply_patches.sh
